translation.name: Biblica® Ochiw Thuolo Motingʼo Loko Manyien™

content.text: “Aol gi ngima;
mano emomiyo ok abi lingʼ ma ok awuoyo,
to abiro wacho lit duto manie chunya.
Abiro wachone Nyasaye niya: Kik ikuma,
to nyisa rachna momiyo ikwana kaka jaketho.
Nyalo bedo ni iwinjo maber ka ahinyora;
kendo ka ikwedo tich lweti, to timbe joricho to mori?
Kara in bende in gi wangʼ mar ringruok?
Koso in bende ineno mana kaka dhano neno?
Kara in bende ndaloni nok ka ndalo dhano,
koso higni magi chalo gi mag dhano,
momiyo imanyo timbena maricho
kendo isiko kimanyo richo moro amora ma an-go,
kata obedo ni ingʼeyo maber ni aonge ketho
kendo ni onge ngʼama nyalo resa e lweti?
“Lweti ema nochweya.
Ibiro lokori koda kendo mondo itieka?
Parie ni ne ichweya koa kuom lowo.
Koro sani, diduoka kendo e lowo adier?
Donge ne iola oko ka chak
kendo ne ipuoya mi apoto ka mo,
ne ichweyo ringra gi choke
kod leche mi iumo chokena gi ringʼo kod pien?
Ne imiya ngima kendo ne itimona ngʼwono,
kendo isebedo ka irito chunya kuom duongʼni maler.
“To kata kamano,
koro angʼeyo ni gik mane ni e pachi e magi:
Isebedo ka ingʼiya mondo ineane ka atimo richo,
to ok iseweya ma ok ikuma.
Okwongʼa, an ngʼat ma timbene mono!
To kata ka aonge ketho,
to pod ok anyal bedo thuolo,
nimar wichkuot ma an-go osemiyo alal ei masichena.
To kata katemo mondo abed thuolo to idwara mana ka sibuor,
kendo isiko mana kiloya gi tekoni maduongʼ.
Ikelo joneno manyien mondo okweda
kendo imedo bedo mager koda;
jolweny magi monja mana ka apaka magingore.
“Angʼo momiyo ne igola ei minwa?
Kara mad ne atho kapok wangʼ moro amora onena.
Mad ne kik nywola,
ka ok kamano to ne onego nywola ka asetho kendo chom koda bur tir!
Donge ngimana modongʼ matin-ni chiegni rumo?
Yie iweya mondo abedie gi yweyo matin,
kapok adhi kuma ji ok dhiye miduogi,
ma en piny motimo mudho gi tipo molil ti,
en piny ma otimo
mudho mandiwa,
kama kata ler chaloe mudho.”
